status: Fixed in source (release-prepublish fail-closed 180s gate); frozen publication and formal closeout remain separate
finding: The npm release workflow used `validate:full --parallel` as the pre-publish compute gate after typecheck, lint, npm test, artifact build, SBOM, portable artifact verification, and frozen runner smoke had already passed in the same immutable job. GitHub Actions run 33245527629 spent 420000 ms (2026-08-29T09:30:08Z to 09:37:08Z) on that full gate. Job logs were not retrievable (403). The same full --parallel contract in validators.config.json serializes exclusive slow lanes (validate-git-hooks-enforcement-full and validate-next-warm-run-latency each declare observedSlowPathMs 360000, plus exclusive release-mirrors validators already proven earlier in the job), which accounts for the measured ~7 minute wall clock without guessing a single validator from code inspection.
expectedBehavior: A release pre-publish gate must cover each package-safety obligation exactly once. Equivalent checks already proven earlier in the same CI run may be consumed only when HEAD and command identity/digest match; missing, stale, mismatched, or unverifiable evidence remains fail-closed. Checks that are not package-artifact safety must remain as a required post-publish validate:full lane, not be deleted. The pre-publish profile must complete in <=180000 ms in a clean CI-equivalent run or fail with ATM_RELEASE_PREPUBLISH_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.
evidenceOrRepro: Run 33245527629 (Release npm packages, tag v0.1.0-beta.1, SHA be99966089afdf88cced735650ac8a4c1df46951) reached terminal failure later in Publish public workspace closure; the compute-gate step itself ran 420000 ms. Repair adds profiles.release-prepublish with explicit consume-prior and execute obligations, --prior-evidence, seal-release-prepublish-evidence.ts, workflow pre-publish plus Post-publish full validation, and tests/cli/release-prepublish-gate.test.ts.
